name: Atuin
param_style: sqlx ?N positional for fixed statements; sql_builder 3.1.1 with values inlined (quote/esc) for search, list and stats
data_scale: scale 1: 120k history rows (8.5k distinct commands, 3k sessions, 5 host strings, 1% soft-deleted), 40k record-store rows over 3 hosts x 4 tags, 2.4k legacy records
visibility_note: 32k stars; every interactive Ctrl-R keystroke runs the search query against a local SQLite history database
interest_note: Interactive search embeds the filtered query twice with a correlated NOT EXISTS row-value dedup; fuzzy LIKE/GLOB masks, lower(hostname) expression-index ranges, a nested-CASE author predicate, window-function dedup, strftime stats over nanosecond timestamps, and a UNION/NOT IN gap finder in the record store.
